<title level="1" right="Spell 2" pfs="Standard">
[Entangling Flora](/Spells.aspx?ID=1515)
<actions string="Two Actions" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Concentrate" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=32" />
<trait label="Manipulate" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=104" />
<trait label="Plant" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=125" />
<trait label="Wood" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=508" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Player Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=216) pg. 329

**Traditions**
[Arcane](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=1), [Primal](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=4)

**Deities**
[Green Man](/Deities.aspx?ID=221), [Nhimbaloth](/Deities.aspx?ID=163)

<row gap="medium">

 

</row>

<row gap="medium">
**Range** 120 feet

**Area** all squares in a 20-foot burst

</row>

<row gap="medium">

**Duration** 1 minute
</row>

</column>

---

Plants and fungi burst out or quickly grow, entangling creatures. All surfaces in the area are [difficult terrain](/Rules.aspx?ID=453). Each round that a creature starts its turn in the area, it must attempt a Reflex save. On a failure, it takes a –10-foot circumstance penalty to its Speeds until it leaves the area, and on a critical failure, it's also [immobilized](/Conditions.aspx?ID=24) for 1 round. Creatures can attempt to [Escape](/Actions.aspx?ID=79) to remove these effects.
name: Entangling Flora
